  "situation": "At a White House briefing, the Secretary of Defense and other senior officials considered the initial USCENTCOM plan for Afghanistan. The Department of Defense had insufficient intelligence on Afghanistan and doubts about the reliability of the intelligence available. The plan was assessed as unlikely to achieve the President’s objectives, while officials feared that a weak response to the September 11 attacks could encourage another attack. The initial proposal assigned special operations forces a supporting role ahead of follow-on conventional forces.
